decision.reason: Release-level official metadata gives a nominal unique-site upper bound above 223, but exact coordinate catalogs, cross-release de-duplication, and a member-level common observation contract are not available for all releases. A release list and deterministic split algorithm can be frozen; member assignments cannot be frozen without reading provider coordinate catalogs.

allowed_inputs: official USGS metadata and catalog/API records
policy.cluster_unit: unique physical transmitter-receiver site after coordinate de-duplication
policy.same_site_rule: Repeated soundings, dates, moments, receivers, currents, stacks, and files at one physical location count once.
policy.deduplication_rule: Normalize coordinates to WGS84; union records within 25 m unless official site identity proves they are distinct; manually adjudicate 25-100 m pairs using only acquisition geometry and official site identifiers; never use response similarity.
policy.cross_release_rule: Apply the same coordinate union across every release, with special review for Shelter Island versus Dering Harbor and all releases sharing a study area.
policy.count_semantics: All counts below are release-level bounds, not frozen eligible members.

why_532_is_not_an_eligible_count: Sounding counts are not always unique-site counts.
Dawson metadata has three incompatible count labels.
Shelter Island and Dering Harbor may contain repeat coordinates.
Several legacy releases lack frozen coordinate catalogs.
Spatial correlation length cannot be estimated outcome-blind from release counts.
The preregistered requirement is 223 independent test clusters, not 223 files or nominal soundings.

not_demonstrated_for_all_releases: digitized transmitter waveform or current-time definition
common_contract_intersection.candidate_subset_warning: Even the WalkTEM subset cannot be member-frozen until exact site catalogs and archive manifests are obtained; instrument family alone does not establish a common waveform, gate, receiver, error, or unit contract.

duplicate_and_dependence_risks: Multiple currents, moments, receiver coils, repeats, dates, stacks, and processed/raw versions inflate file counts.
Closely spaced sites along a transect are spatially correlated and cannot automatically count as independent clusters.
Dering Harbor is geographically within Shelter Island and requires coordinate-level cross-release de-duplication.
Report soundings may later have been republished as data releases.
Dense towed-tTEM samples are one correlated trajectory, not thousands of independent sites.

pre_access_exclusions: Dinero SiteList member from calibration and test because outcome columns were exposed during this inventory
all inverted-model files and maps from split construction
all members without a provider site key or coordinate mapping
all duplicate raw/processed representations after one canonical raw member is selected

steps: Acquire only official archive manifests and provider coordinate catalogs; hash and make them read-only before any response member is opened.
Normalize site coordinates to WGS84 and apply the frozen 25 m union rule across releases.
Assign one canonical site key as SHA256(round(latitude,6)|round(longitude,6)|provider_site_id).
Build spatial connected components using a predeclared buffer distance that is at least the maximum of 100 m and the largest transmitter-loop diagonal in metadata.
Order components by SHA256('wp8-tem-v1|' + component_canonical_key), never by response or quality.
Allocate whole components in order to train, buffer, calibration, and sealed test; require at least 223 test components after any later training-only correlation-length expansion.
If 223 independent sealed-test components cannot be retained together with nonempty train, buffer, and calibration sets, fail without opening observations.
Keep calibration and test archives sealed; training-only diagnostics may only occur after the member manifest, hashes, and assignments are frozen.

minimum_partition_constraints.train_components: nonempty and sufficient for the preregistered training-only diagnostics

metadata_boundary_incident.cause: A provider file named SiteList was opened as a coordinate catalog but also contained inversion residual, conductor, and usability columns.
metadata_boundary_incident.effect: No response values were used and no gate changed, but the member is disqualified from calibration/test metadata construction.
metadata_boundary_incident.remediation: Use the ScienceBase record and archive filenames for Dinero release inventory; exclude the entire SiteList member from calibration/test and never use its outcome columns for selection.

unblock_conditions: Resolve exact official identifiers for Hueco Bolson, Utah FORGE, and MAP.
Obtain and hash official site-coordinate catalogs and archive manifests for every retained release without opening response members.
Prove license/reuse status at the data-file level for legacy report releases.
Produce a coordinate-deduplicated member manifest with canonical raw member hashes.
Demonstrate the complete common contract for every retained member or restrict to a documented compatible subset.
Apply the frozen geographic split and show at least 223 sealed independent test components after buffer/correlation requirements.
